purpose: Design for the backend-independent body of /forge:review: backend resolution, targets and allowlist, fix safety checks, location-based splitting, staged presentation and the single terminal exit.
summary: Overview of the review body orchestrating request publishing, reviewer and evaluator agents
Backend resolution by name to forge:<name> SKILL, fail closed on explicit specs, retains_context declaration
Default candidate order (agent-review only) and .forge.yaml review.backend as the only setting
Module list and responsibilities of body scripts and exchange scripts
Base branch handoff to resolve_targets.py and allowlist consistency
Single terminal exit with four paths: approved, halted_with_open_findings, failure, interrupted
Handling of reviewer and evaluator results, request immutability across rounds
Split by location and the two confidences (fix_confident vs confidence), --auto behavior
Staged presentation delegated to consult in the same context
Use cases, test design, and open item TBD-002
tasks: Modifying the /forge:review SKILL or its scripts
Changing the terminal handling of a review
Reviewing design documents for the review feature
Writing tests for review body scripts
title: DES-066 `/forge:review` 本体（バックエンド非依存部）設計書
